You must quote this number in all communications with U R A and business transactions. Would you like more detail?

If you face challenges during registration, you can reach out to U R A through their contact centre at 0 800, 117, 0 0 0 or 0 800, 217, 0 0 0, or via email at services at U R A dot go dot u g.
